conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 2. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.
